scope.captureBoundary: Core/environment PNGs sample the padded data-visual-frame including the primary checkbox, disabled-selected comparison and output/error text. Zoom PNGs are the complete current visible viewport1264x805 physical pixels; inventory is a1280x720 default-demo viewport.

findings.observation: The first checkbox visibly remains disabled and checked, and native toBeDisabled/toBeChecked pass; the Demo output says 当前选择: off.
findings.cause: The public checked prop uses state === 'disabled-selected' || checked, while output uses only checked. The initial checked=false makes the Demo output disagree with the effective controlled value.
findings.minimalRecommendation: After all reviews preserve this candidate, derive effectiveChecked/effectiveIndeterminate once for both the control and output and add feedback assertions. Do not change Checkbox product rendering or reinterpret native passed evidence.

conclusions: All112 original PNGs were individually opened at original detail, including repeated hashes, rather than treating native pass as visual approval.
The checkbox control rendering itself shows distinct checked tick and mixed dash, neutral disabled value retention, and error outlines/fills in the inspected three sizes and both modes.
Hover and actual mouse-down pressed pictures retain their circle state layers; keyboard focus pictures retain an independent complete outer ring without crop.
Touch uses actual label tap and native coarse-pointer plus48x48 control bounds. The PNG preserves state layer, tick, label and comparison item.
320px and English long labels wrap without clipping; RTL reverses control/label placement; brand/forced-colors/reduced-motion remain scoped to the sampled environment.

Real200% proof uses chrome.tabs.setZoom=2 while html/body CSS zoom remain1; physical viewport1264x805, CSS viewport632x402. Selected state, focus ring, long label, disabled comparison and output are visible. These are not full-page screenshots.

Half-selection is driven by public indeterminate and native aria-checked=mixed; off boolean output alone is not evidence that a mixed indicator failed. The separately documented disabled-selected output contradiction remains a Demo issue.
The two inventory PNGs cover only the default demo. Native configuration-preservation has no PNG and is not counted as manual image acceptance.
